skills.name: QA_source_index
skills.usage: 回答 QwenPaw 安装/配置/技能/MCP/多Agent/记忆等问题时，按关键词定位官方文档与源码入口，减少盲目搜索
skills.description: Maps topics and keywords from user questions to QwenPaw official documentation paths and common source code entry points, reducing blind searching. Intended for the built-in QA Agent to quickly identify which files to read when answering questions about installation, configuration, skills, MCP, multi-agent, memory, CLI, etc.
skills.description_zh: 将问题关键词映射到 QwenPaw 官方文档路径与常见源码入口，减少盲目搜索。内置 QA Agent 用它快速定位该读哪些文件。

skills.name: file_reader
skills.usage: 用户要求读取或总结本地文本文件时使用（.txt/.md/.json/.log 等）；PDF/Office/图片由其他 skill 处理
skills.description: Read and summarize text-based file types only. Prefer read_file for text formats; use execute_shell_command for type detection when needed. PDF/Office/images/archives are handled by other skills.
skills.description_zh: 读取并总结纯文本类文件（仅限文本格式），优先用 read_file；需要时用 execute_shell_command 探测类型。PDF/Office/图片/压缩包由其他 skill 负责。
